answer: Each identity plants one lotus in a shared jade garden, staking 8 credits on its plot. Every lotus root must be kept clear of every other, so the k-th fake pays to untangle k-1 crossings at 2 credits each: 8 + 2(k-1). Ten fakes cost 170 credits, a hundred cost 10,700, and the garden caps at 200 plots, after which a new fake must buy out a plot at triple stake.
